package.name: f1tenth_hydra
package.description: Hydra (MIT-SPARK) 3D scene graph for the F1TENTH stack: the launch (hydra.launch.py, profiles, seg_source gt or mobilenet, pose_source isaac_gt or stack_tf), its configs, the RViz config and a small Python scene graph viewer. Hydra itself is NOT a dependency: its sources are pinned submodules in third_party/hydra_ros (ignored by this workspace's colcon build), built into their own workspace (~/hydra_ws, see docs/hydra_hil.md) and found at launch time, so this workspace builds and runs unchanged without it.
